infrastructure.name: Chennai Metro Phase 2 – Corridor 3 (Purple Line, Madhavaram Milk Colony – SIPCOT Siruseri)
infrastructure.status_2026: 45.4 km corridor with 48 stations (28 underground) running from Madhavaram through central Chennai (Purasawalkam, Thousand Lights, Mylapore, Adyar, Thiruvanmiyur) and then down OMR to Siruseri SIPCOT. Underground tunneling is well advanced — one of the twin tunnels from Madhavaram Milk Colony to Venugopal Nagar is complete with the second nearing completion. The elevated OMR section (Nehru Nagar/Perungudi to Siruseri) is targeted to open in stages roughly 2026–2028, with full corridor completion by end-2028.
infrastructure.expected_completion: Elevated OMR stretch in stages ~2026–2028; full corridor incl. underground by end-2028

infrastructure.name: Chennai Metro Phase 2 – Corridor 4 (Yellow Line, Lighthouse – Poonamallee Bypass)
infrastructure.status_2026: 26.1 km, 27–28 stations (16 km elevated west of Kodambakkam, 10.1 km underground to Lighthouse). The western elevated stretch (Poonamallee Bypass–Porur, ~9–10 km/10 stations) was announced for a Dec 2025 launch, and the longer Poonamallee Bypass–Vadapalani section (14.6 km) received CMRS safety clearance (reported late Feb 2026, with a final inspection also reported cleared in May 2026); however Wikipedia and mid-2026 reports state the public opening was postponed past the TN Assembly election and was expected in the second/third week of July 2026 pending government approval — exact opening date is unclear as of 20 Jul 2026 and sources conflict on whether any stretch is yet carrying passengers. A 43.6 km extension from Poonamallee toward Parandur had its DPR approved by GoTN in June 2025 (now uncertain given the airport rethink).
infrastructure.data_confidence: medium (opening-date reports conflict: Dec 2025 announcement vs Feb/May 2026 safety clearances vs July 2026 expected public opening)

infrastructure.name: Chennai Metro Phase 2 – Corridor 5 (Red Line, Madhavaram Milk Colony – Sholinganallur)
infrastructure.status_2026: 44.6–47 km orbital corridor with ~45 stations (only 6 underground), linking north Chennai to the OMR IT belt via Retteri, Villivakkam, Koyambedu, Vadapalani, Alandur, Madipakkam and Medavakkam. Elevated works are on track — roughly 150 piers done Madhavaram–Koyambedu, 142 Koyambedu–Ullagaram and 205 Ullagaram–ELCOT — and the first operational stretch (Madhavaram Milk Colony–Retteri) is anticipated before end-2026; CMRL has also revised the operational plan to open an Alandur-anchored phase before extending to Sholinganallur.
infrastructure.expected_completion: First stretch (Madhavaram–Retteri) by end-2026; full corridor ~2028

infrastructure.name: Chennai Peripheral Ring Road (CPRR, Ennore Port – Mamallapuram)
infrastructure.status_2026: 132.87 km, 6-lane access-controlled expressway (10 lanes incl. service roads, 120 km/h design, ~Rs 12,301 crore) arcing from Ennore Port via Thatchur (NH16), Periyapalayam, Thamaraipakkam, Tiruvallur, Sriperumbudur and Singaperumal Koil to Poonjeri near Mamallapuram. As of 2026 ~79% of work is reported complete; Phase 1 (Ennore–Thatchur, 25.31 km, JICA-funded) is in advanced construction, intermediate sections are underway, and bidders (KNR, RR Infra, Notch India) have been selected for the final Singaperumal Koil–Poonjeri phase (27.41 km, 4 packages), with year-end 2026 targeted for substantial completion. Ennore–Mamallapuram travel time is projected to drop from ~3 hours to ~1 hour.
infrastructure.expected_completion: Substantial completion targeted end-2026; final southern phase likely spills into 2027

infrastructure.name: Parandur Greenfield Airport (Chennai second airport)
infrastructure.status_2026: Project in serious doubt. The Rs 27,400 crore, 5,746-acre airport proposed by the DMK government in 2022 had acquired roughly 1,700 acres of private land (some reports cite ~3,000 acres total including government land) by mid-2026, against sustained protests in Ekanapuram and 12 other villages plus compensation disputes in court. Following the 2026 change of government, CM Vijay first ordered a status quo halting acquisition, and on 18 June 2026 the TVK government announced it will not proceed at Parandur — citing impact on waterbodies and farmland — and will identify an alternative site for Chennai's second airport; no alternative site or timeline has been named, and the fate of acquired land and the planned Poonamallee–Parandur metro extension is unresolved.
infrastructure.data_confidence: medium (political situation fluid in 2026; acreage figures differ between sources — noted conflict)

infrastructure.name: OMR IT Corridor expansion – new tech parks and Grade-A office supply (2024–2026)
infrastructure.status_2026: A large wave of Grade-A IT space is under construction/announced on OMR: Sattva Knowledge City (~4.5 mn sq ft), DLF Downtown Taramani Phase 2 (~3.7 mn sq ft), TCS Siruseri expansion (~3.3 mn sq ft), Bagmane Viva (~3 mn sq ft), Baashyaam Semmancheri (~3 mn sq ft), Casagrand Bizpark (~1.1 mn sq ft) and Brigade Trillium (~1.1 mn sq ft). This supply is timed to Metro Corridor 3's elevated OMR line (Perungudi–Siruseri targeted ~2028) and a proposed multi-deck elevated corridor on OMR; no major brand-new SEZ notifications in 2024–26 were found (growth is via private IT parks and SIPCOT IT Park Siruseri expansion), which is noted as a gap.
infrastructure.data_confidence: medium (project pipeline well-sourced; individual delivery dates not confirmed)

infrastructure.name: OMR Phase 2 widening (Siruseri – Mamallapuram) with Sholinganallur grade separator
infrastructure.status_2026: The 25 km Rajiv Gandhi Salai stretch from Siruseri to Mamallapuram is being widened to six lanes, including bypasses at Kelambakkam and Thiruporur; GoTN sanctioned Rs 465.13 crore for acquiring 88.62 ha across 13 villages, with acquisition complete in 9 villages and ongoing in 4 as of the latest highways department updates. A grade separator/flyover at Sholinganallur (tied to the metro interchange hub design) is planned to ease access to Karapakkam, Medavakkam, Semmancheri and ECR.
infrastructure.expected_completion: Unclear — land acquisition still in progress as of 2025-26; no firm completion date published

infrastructure.name: ECR Elevated Corridor (Thiruvanmiyur/Tidel Park – Uthandi) and ECR six-laning
infrastructure.status_2026: Tamil Nadu is planning a ~14.2 km elevated road on East Coast Road built on the median from near Tidel Park/Thiruvanmiyur to Uthandi, alongside six-laning of ECR through Neelankarai, Injambakkam and Sholinganallur villages (TNRDC project). As of 2026 this remains in planning/early-works stage — an announced project rather than one under full construction — so timelines are unclear.
infrastructure.data_confidence: low-medium (announced; construction status and dates not confirmed)

infrastructure.name: Oragadam–Sriperumbudur electronics & EV manufacturing belt (Foxconn/Tata Electronics/Pegatron cluster)
infrastructure.status_2026: The belt (22+ Fortune 500 firms, six global carmakers) is absorbing major 2024–26 electronics investments: Tata Electronics acquired Wistron's India operations (Mar 2024) and a controlling 60% stake in Pegatron Technology India (announced Jan 2025), consolidating iPhone assembly near Chennai; TN approved Foxconn subsidiary Yuzhan Technology's Rs 13,180 crore (~$1.6 bn) smartphone display module plant at ESR Oragadam Industrial & Logistics Park (~14,000 jobs), with a further iPhone-enclosures unit planned in the same park. Note: VinFast's Rs 16,000 crore EV plant, inaugurated 4 Aug 2025, is at SIPCOT Thoothukudi — southern TN, not the Chennai belt — despite frequent association with this corridor. TN reported over Rs 10 lakh crore ($120 bn) investment commitments 2021–25, much of it along this corridor.
infrastructure.expected_completion: Foxconn display module plant ramp ~2026-27; cluster expansion ongoing

infrastructure.name: Chennai data center build-out (Ambattur & Siruseri campuses)
infrastructure.status_2026: Chennai's DC market (~202 MW in 2025, projected ~551 MW by 2030 at ~22% CAGR) is expanding on two poles: STT GDC opened STT Chennai 7 at Siruseri SIPCOT (7.2 MW live, campus designed for 45 MW, AI-ready) and broke ground on a new ~90 MW campus at Ambattur where it already has ~40 MW operational plus an 18 MW STT Chennai 4 under development; Equinix opened its first Chennai IBX (CN1) at Siruseri — AI-ready, liquid-cooling capable, 800 cabinets in phase 1 scaling to ~4,250. This anchors long-term commercial demand at both the OMR-south (Siruseri) and west-industrial (Ambattur) submarkets.

infrastructure.name: Chennai MRTS: Velachery–St. Thomas Mount extension and MRTS–CMRL merger
infrastructure.status_2026: The long-pending 5 km MRTS extension from Velachery to St. Thomas Mount has completed civil works and load tests, with services reported set to begin around end-Dec 2025/Jan 2026, finally linking the Beach–Velachery elevated line to the Metro/suburban interchange at St. Thomas Mount. In parallel, the Railway Board gave in-principle approval to merge the 19.34 km MRTS into CMRL — transferring assets and operations from Southern Railway, with plans for 25 AC broad-gauge rakes, station modernisation and unified ticketing under CUMTA. Exact commissioning date of the extension and merger completion are not yet confirmed.
infrastructure.expected_completion: Extension: ~early 2026 (reported, unconfirmed); merger/modernisation: multi-year, no firm date

infrastructure.name: New SIPCOT industrial parks & TN industrial policy pipeline affecting the CMA
infrastructure.status_2026: SIPCOT has ~19 new industrial parks in the pipeline statewide, several inside or adjacent to the Chennai Metropolitan Area: Thirumudivakkam (Chennai), a ~1,500-acre park at Gummidipoondi (largest in the pipeline), plus new parks in Tiruvallur, Kancheepuram and Ranipet (Panapakkam) districts — layouts are being finalised and land assembly is underway. These sit alongside TN's broader 2021–25 investment drive (Rs 10+ lakh crore commitments via successive Global Investors Meets) and existing SIPCOT expansions at Siruseri IT Park, Oragadam and Vallam Vadagal; individual park commissioning dates are not yet published.
infrastructure.data_confidence: medium (pipeline confirmed; individual park timelines unclear)
